# AI Tools FAQ

*Last updated: September 2025*

**Q: Can I use Cursor with client data?**
A: Yes, as long as Privacy Mode is turned on. Privacy Mode means your code is not stored or used for training.

**Q: How do I get Claude?**
A: Ping Jamie Lee in IT, or use go/ai-access.

**Q: Can I use ChatGPT for first drafts?**
A: Yes, for non-confidential text.

**Q: Is there a list of approved tools?**
A: The AI Task Force is working on one. For now, see the AI Acceptable Use Policy.

**Q: Who do I ask about AI questions?**
A: #ai-help on Slack.
